Hymn 164: Great God, to Thee My Evening Song
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Joseph J. Daynes
Lyricist/Text Author: Anne Steele
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 164 titled "Great God, to Thee My Evening Song" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph J. Daynes and the lyrics were written by Anne Steele.
